titulo: Por mí, que... vs para mí que...
subtitulo: Por mí, que se casen. Para mí que se van a casar.
regla: Por mí (que) + present subjunctive = I don't mind if..., it's fine by me (indifference or even approval): Por mí, que se vayan. Para mí que + indicative = I have a feeling that..., I reckon: Para mí que va a llover. One shows your permission; the other your hunch.

bloques.texto: _I don't care if... / I wouldn't mind if..._: indifference or approval; tone decides.
Also alone: **Por mí, está bien.** = _Fine by me._
_I have a feeling that..., I bet..._: a hunch or opinion.

lista.es: ==Por mí, que se casen==. Yo ya tengo otro en mente.
lista.en: As far as I'm concerned, they can get married. I've got someone else in mind.

lista.es: ==Por mí, que se casen==. Tengo ganas de ir a una boda.
lista.en: I'd love it if they got married. I feel like going to a wedding.

lista.es: ==Para mí que se van a casar==. Se ven tan enamorados.
lista.en: I bet they're going to get married. They look so in love.

lista.es: —¿Vamos en carro o en metro? —==Por mí==, como quieras.
lista.en: —Car or subway? —I don't mind, whatever you want.
I have a feeling he's not coming anymore.

filas.t: Para mí que se casan / se van a casar.

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.p: In Spanish: _As far as I'm concerned, they can leave._
In Spanish: _I reckon it's going to rain._
lista.r: Para mí que va a llover.

lista.p: Which means _I have a hunch_? _Por mí que.../ Para mí que..._
